properties.description: The population half of the derived-relation check: a function that reads an edge and is on neither this list nor a declaration's reach fails the build, so a new derived relation cannot arrive unseen.
properties.name: edge_readers.yaml — every function in reflow2-core that names an edge type and that no derived declaration answers for, with the edges it names; 128 unjudged (only shrinks), 53 judged not_derived
